title: A trade to rebuild up front leads our Eagles-only mock draft

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: A trade to rebuild up front leads our Eagles-only mock draft
sources.description: With the NFL’s free agency frenzy finally calming down, many teams’ shopping lists were shortened, having addressed immediate needs in the opening hours and days of the new league year. What the Eagles did get as the league year opened is four shiny new draft picks, a result of losing free agents to other teams a year ago. Howie Roseman did not make many big moves when free agency opened, somewhat expected, considering the big-name players he likely will sign to new contracts in the next year or so.
